verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official Stripe CLI for building, testing, and managing Stripe integrations from the terminal. Terminal is part of the Stripe API surface, so the CLI plausibly applies, but nothing in the pack shows Terminal-specific CLI commands such as reader or location management or the simulated reader. Missing for 10: evidence that the CLI covers Terminal resources (readers, locations, simulated readers), documentation of AI/agent-oriented CLI workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use with Terminal.
